outcome.answer: Several approaches can help. A prompt can ask the model to plan the response and count words as it writes, improving adherence without retraining [1]. A training-free alternative provides dynamic length feedback during generation so the model can adjust toward a target word, token, or sentence count [2]. For translation with strict duration limits, reinforcement learning can optimize length compliance alongside meaning [3]. A simple conciseness reminder can also reduce excessively long outputs [7].
